title: Will Mud by Remi Wolf have above 10000 Album Equivalent Units during the October 9, 2026 - October 15, 2026 tracking week? Above 10K
rules: If Mud by Remi Wolf has above 10K Album Equivalent Units during the October 9, 2026 - October 15, 2026, tracking week, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This event pertains to the U.S. and will resolve based on the value reported by Luminate’s API as of 10:00 AM ET on the Sunday immediately following the October 9, 2026 - October 15, 2026 tracking week.

Luminate Data, LLC is a neutral provider of market metrics which does not endorse, verify or participate in any way in the outcomes of any prediction market.

blind.reasoning: Mud came out October 9, 2026, so this is its first full week out. Remi Wolf's previous album, Big Ideas, debuted at only No. 95 on the Billboard 200 in July 2024, which from memory usually meant about 10K units, right at this threshold. Signed and colored vinyl bundles, a John Mayer feature, a tour announced on release day and two years of fan growth push slightly toward clearing 10K. But the album's stripped-back sound and modest streaming numbers make it close to a coin flip.
blind.falsifier: Luminate or Billboard reporting Mud's first-week total at or below 10,000 units (e.g., a debut outside roughly the top 100 of the Billboard 200).

final.reasoning: The 0.83 midpoint probably reflects post-release sales information, while my estimate rests only on a No. 95 debut whose unit count I'm unsure of, so I moved up from 0.54 to 0.70. The remaining gap is too small, and my information too weak, to bet NO confidently.
